owned_invariants: Every admitted rational has exactly one accepted spelling.
Booleans and floats are never admitted.
Every refusal is an AdmissionError with code ADMISSION.
boundaries: Callers outside the core receive only Fraction, int and str values that passed these checks.

score.level_basis: The single admission gate for every value that enters the core: canonical-form rationals (one spelling per value, so hashes bind values), bool-safe integers, bounded names, and the typed failure hierarchy with stable codes that every front end translates.

basis.G1: Header declares AuthorityEffect: None and a unique contract URN; the exported names (__all__ or public types) are the ones the docstring describes and the contract lists. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond this contract.
basis.G2: Exact profile: Fractions only from integer pairs parsed from canonical strings (RULE_PY_004); bool refused by type(v) is not int (RULE_PY_002); length bound before parsing; non-canonical spellings refused. Not A: no machine-checked proof of the canonical-form bijection.
basis.G3: Every expected failure is a typed exception with a stable code (AdmissionError, BudgetExceededError, UnknownPackError) or a typed verdict; no assert in production code (Ruff S101, AST test) and the whole suite passes under python -O; no bare or broad except (Ruff BLE001/E722). Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: Unit and boundary tests for every branch, negative tests for each refusal, run under pytest and under python -O. Hypothesis round-trips format/parse; the documented limits are pinned with literals. Mutation R = 1/1 (see mutation_accounting).
basis.G5: Functions are single-purpose; complexity measured per function. Metrics: worst function: cyclomatic 7, cognitive 6, nesting 1; metrics ceiling A+.
